title: S031 — Incremental execution state lifecycle / production boundary validation
description: Characterize the lifecycle, isolation, persistence, rewind, branching and real performance boundary of the S030 incremental execution state before any productionization.
result_summary: HOLD. The execution-state lifecycle is validated: initialization 50/50, rewind 50/50, branch cloning 50/50, determinism 50/50. Execution state = { model, truth } -> O(model), reconstructible from canon+prefix or WorldState, and NOT part of stateHash/identityHash. Clean production boundary: CanonicalModel + WorldState + IncrementalPhaseAState, where IncrementalPhaseAState is execution state only. BUT the S024 synthetic corpus (which S029/S030 never ran) reveals 5 of 100 randomized topologies failing (1487/1500 prefixes), so the S028 dependency boundary (validated only on Verrin/Ordos) is INCOMPLETE for some synthetic SCC/OR topologies. This is a CORRECTNESS gap in the dependency index, not a lifecycle defect. Per the failure discipline scaling was stopped; the failure was classified as dependency-index incompleteness on synthetic topologies and was NOT patched; the 5 topologies were not minimised (budget).
failure_class: dependency-index incompleteness on synthetic SCC/OR topologies (not patched, not minimised)
next_experiment: minimise and characterise the 5 failing S024 topologies, identify the missing authoritative dependency class, extend the index only if causally justified, and re-run the S024 corpus to zero.
limitations: Only 5/100 failures detected; they were not minimised.
Different fair queue orders were not swept.
15-step history per synthetic topology; deeper histories may reveal more failures.
